ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rhombus $ABCD$, the diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$. Point $E$ is the midpoint of side $AB$. If $OE=4$, what is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus,\\
it follows that AB = BC = CD = AD, and BD$\perp$AC,\\
Furthermore, since point E is the midpoint of side AB,\\
it follows that OE = AE = EB $ =\frac{1}{2}$ AB,\\
Therefore, BC = AB = 2OE = $4\times 2$ = \boxed{8}
